items: Member and author identities now appear consistently across events, pages, histories, spaces, selectors, and home feeds.
Display names and avatars now use richer membership and connected-identity information, with sensible fallbacks when details are unavailable.
Author identities can link directly to member profiles in more event, history, tagging, and member-list views.
Event links now use stable event identifiers, improving navigation from timelines and feeds.
Relayed event details show the originating space only when it is relevant.
The “All your events” feed now combines events with their associated author identities for clearer context.
